options.name: action
options.description: C(add) will add new SNMP community strings and/or SNMP managers C(set) will replace SNMP community strings and/or SNMP managers. An empty list for either C(community_strings) or C(permitted_managers) will result in the respective lists being removed entirely. C(remove) will remove SNMP community strings and/or SNMP managers

options.name: community_strings
options.description: The list of read-only SNMP community strings.

options.name: permitted_managers
options.description: The list of permitted SNMP managers.
